text:
Marta: Drafting PRD for Dedicated capacity SLA + autoscale. Need buy-in on target SLAs, sizing calc, autoscale policy, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. Linking initial doc: https://redwood.internal/prd/dedicated-sla-draft :eyes:
Eli: Added a throughput table to the doc. Need real workload profiles to finalize QPS-per-GPU numbers. @Sophia can you share NovaMaps peak/percentile traffic?
Sophia: NovaMaps peak: ~15k qps for embedding+rerank blend during business hours, typical request ~512 tokens. They want 99.9% availability and p99 gen latency <300ms. Willing to sign reserved commit if we can guarantee latency SLA.
Zane: Sizing note: 15k qps @512 tokens implies pre-warmed pool + burst buffer. Cold-start for new nodes ~90s under current infra. Recommend warm pool + short-term burst capacity with fallback to cheaper model variant.
Eli: Proposed autoscale policy (early sketch):
```json
{
  "min_replicas": 4,
  "max_replicas": 200,
  "scale_metric": "rps_per_gpu",
  "target": 250,
  "scale_policy": [
    {"type": "step", "step_size": 2, "cooldown_s": 60},
    {"type": "predictive", "horizon_s": 30, "smoothing": 0.6}
  ]
}
```
Eli: This assumes rps_per_gpu target=250 for the chosen model profile; numbers will change per model/quantization.
Marta: Draft acceptance criteria (need edits):
- SLA: 99.9% availability for dedicated pool (billing window basis)
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 targets per model variant (p99 <300ms for NovaMaps baseline)
- Throughput: documented supported sustained throughput and burst headroom
- Autoscale: no more than 120s to reach steady-state for +50% sustained load after warm-pool pre-warm
- Rollback: automated fallback to lower-cost model within 30s if error rate or quality regression detected
Harry: Edge cases to call out: KV cache cold starts causing huge latency spikes, token-burst workloads (e.g., 10x RPS for 10s), model-variant downgrade quality regression, noisy neighbor multi-tenant hotspots. Need per-customer isolation knobs and circuit breakers.
Zane: Ops acceptance items:
- Run sizing simulator for 15k qps @512 tokens vs current runtime perf
- Chaos test: random 20% node kill, validate failover <120s for canary traffic and no SLA breach on reserved pools
- Observability: token-level cost, per-route p99, and eviction/kvcache hit-rate metrics surfaced to Console
Eli: Also need policy for graceful degradation: fallback options ordered by quality->latency->cost, e.g., full model -> quantized q4 -> smaller model -> queue with 503 hints. Instrument A/B to measure quality delta.
Harry: Add eval acceptance: quality regression threshold per prompt set (e.g., BLEU/ROUGE or human eval acceptable delta <2% for critical flows). If threshold breached, autoscaler should block model switch and trigger rollback.
Sophia: For sales: customers prefer latency & availability guarantees over cost initially; NovaMaps OK with 10-20% premium for SLA. I'll draft contract language once we lock numbers.
deploy-bot: New PRD created: https://redwood.internal/prd/dedicated-sla-1789 by Marta
Marta: Next steps: @Eli please draft RFC for the autoscaler config + cooldowns, @Zane run the sizing sim and post numbers, @Harry add edge-case test matrix to the doc. Sync Wed 10:00am PT.
Eli: Will do. Adding a small simulation job to run tonight and will post results tomorrow.
Zane: I'll spin up a warm-pool test and include cold-start timings.
Harry: I'll author the test matrix, include burst and cache-cold scenarios.
Marta: Thanks all — aim to finalize acceptance criteria before Wed so we can present to GTM. :thumbsup:
